findings.title: Implementation file record objects are incompatible with unchanged gate
findings.evidence: Preparation2 files values are SHA256 strings. Preparation3 all486 values are objects {sha256,bytes}. load_gate directly compares sha((P/f).read_bytes()) == h, which is always false for a dictionary. The first record README.md would be refused before a subprocess attempt. This is a static type/shape inference, not an observed helper failure.
findings.requestedCorrection: Freeze a separate DATA-only successor whose implementation files values remain SHA strings, as required by accepted gate; keep byte counts in complete physical preparation index. Rehash every dependent control/index pin and genuine forward/inverse adaptation. Preserve all five helper bytes and all original packets.
